messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: `high_5xx_rate` fired for service=dedicated-inference-router region=us-east-1. Threshold: 5% 5xx over 60s. ⏰
PagerDuty: Alert details: https://pagerduty.example/alerts/PD12345 (auto-retry policy ON)
Maya: acking — I'm on it, looking at router metrics + autoscaler.
Maya: quick check: router error rate jumped to ~8% around 14:02 UTC, then dipped, then spiked again. looks oscillatory.
Jamal: I saw the noise. Could be the dedicated pool autoscaler thrashing after a node drain. stacking short-lived 502/504s.
Sofia: Any customer-facing tickets yet? Support dashboard shows 3 ERR responses in the last 10m for customer alpha-corp. emailing them now.
Maya: grabbing logs from routers: `kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=router -o wide` shows 3/8 pods restarting in last 4m.
Maya: logs snippet:
```
2026-03-15T14:01:58Z router-5f8c: upstream request timed out, status=504, latency_ms=5003
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z router-7c2d: connection reset by peer -> backend gpu-pool-12
2026-03-15T14:02:45Z router-5f8c: upstream 502 Bad Gateway from gpu-proxy-3
```
Jamal: interesting — router timeouts coincide with GPU workers being OOM/killed during quick scale-out. autoscaler rapid swing: +6 nodes then -5 in <2m.
Maya: that explains transient failures and multiple PD rules firing. looks like autoscaler cooldown is too aggressive for our workload profile.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: alert auto-resolved (PD12345) — no acknowledgements required (auto-resolve).
Maya: PD auto-resolved but I'm keeping this thread open until stable for 10m. still seeing small blips.
Sofia: emailed alpha-corp: "We observed a brief service disruption around 14:02 UTC impacting a subset of requests. Root cause under investigation; will follow up."
Jamal: mitigation applied: bumped autoscaler cooldown from 60s -> 180s and increased min replicas for gpu-pool to 4 (temp). patch: `kubectl patch hpa gpu-pool --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'`
Maya: also temporarily increased router replica readinessTimeout to reduce restart churn. will watch.
Maya: metrics: 5xx back under 1.2% now. CPU on gpu nodes stable.
PagerDuty: New alert PD12346: duplicate trigger on a different rule (short window).
Maya: acking PD12346, marking as probable duplicate of PD12345 root cause (autoscaler oscillation).
Jamal: creating follow-up ticket INF-4523: "autoscaler cooldown + scaling-safety for dedicated gpu pools" with runbook steps and link to logs.
Maya: customer impact summary for postmortem: ~0.6% of overall requests experienced 5xx, peak 2.1% for ~90s. no SLO breach after rolling window calc, but visible user errors for some customers (alpha-corp reported failures).
Sofia: support case pinned to INF-4523, alpha-corp notified with ETA for follow-up.
oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff reminder: Jamal (taking next shift) in 20m — please leave notes. :spiral_calendar: 
Maya: leaving notes: autoscaler briefly thrashing after a node drain; temp mitigation: cooldown=180s, minReplicas=4; created INF-4523; watch 5xx for 30m.
Jamal: taking handoff. I'll verify cooldown stays applied and schedule a safer scaling policy (rate-limit scale up and down).
incident-bot: Thread closed automatically (no active PD alerts).
Maya: marking thread resolved locally, follow-up in INF-4523. :white_check_mark:
